text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (19.9% vs 3.2%, 8.14, z 2.86, 24%, 30 docs, 5 documented 99215s, 0 below billed, 24 notes/2 no lab). However, several claims are unsupported by the card or contradictory, and the next steps are generic and misaligned with the narrative.","problems":["Claims '9% for the comparison providers' for below-billed rate; the card gives 0.087 as all_provider_rate for 99215 documented below billed, so 9% is plausible, but it is a comparison to all providers, not specifically 'comparison providers'.","Note-signal figures (problems 17%, late 0%, unsigned 0%, data 7%) and 'No audit trail was received' are not on the evidence card; they may come from tool outputs but cannot be verified here.","Mentions a 'repeated-time signal' and says C0073123 appears among note-signal examples; neither is on the card, so these look ungrounded.","Claims 'several times the all-provider rate in every complexity tier' – true per the table (e.g., 0.08 vs 0.018), but the 'uniform upward billing habit' inference is overstated given the share rises sharply with complexity (0.08 to 0.733) and the summary also says inconclusive.","Says C0073123 'age 20, no chronic conditions, R10.9' is documented at high MDM, which matches the card, but calling it 'weak evidence the note may be inflated' is speculative.","Final next_steps cite C0073157 (a 99214 documented below billed) as a starting chart for 99215 review, which is mismatched; the narrative's better targets (C0072822, C0072892, C0073090, C0073319) are not in the formal steps.","Example claims are formulaic and low-complexity examples are chosen arbitrarily (first rows) rather than the most telling ones; next steps are generic and do not specify chart counts or the 24 vs. low-complexity comparison."]}
